episodes.name: First Blood
episodes.overviewEn: Wolverine begins experiencing vivid, haunting flashbacks about an ancient, primal, werewolf-like race known as the Lupine. His uneasy peace is shattered when Sabretooth launches a savage, unexpected ambush, dragging Logan into a brutal brawl that forces him to question the true origin of their mutual animosity.

episodes.name: Deja Vu
episodes.overviewEn: Logan seeks answers to his recurring visions at the Xavier Institute, but the line between his past and present continues to blur. As Sabretooth relentlessly tracks him, the psychological toll increases, pushing Logan closer to his untamed, feral roots while trying to maintain control over his berserker instincts.

episodes.name: Blood on the Wind
episodes.overviewEn: The conflict goes global, shifting to Africa where Wolverine crosses paths with Storm and Black Panther. Sabretooth's trail of mindless slaughter forces Logan into a deadly hunting match across the savanna, where he discovers that their century-long blood feud is being orchestrated by a much larger, darker network.

episodes.name: Insomnia
episodes.overviewEn: Tortured by nightmares and unable to rest, Logan encounters Wild Child, another mutant suffering from a fractured mind and primal degeneration. Through these encounters, Logan uncovers horrifying pieces of the puzzle regarding Weapon X and a mythical, immortal manipulator pulling their strings from the shadows.

episodes.name: Wake the Dead
episodes.overviewEn: Logan journeys back to the old, abandoned Weapon X facility in search of the truth. There, he makes a sickening discovery: Romulus has been breeding highly accurate, mindless Sabretooth clones to experiment on and torment him, leading to a desperate, claustrophobic battle for survival against an army of his worst nightmare.

episodes.name: Quod Sum Eris
episodes.overviewEn: Translating to "What I am, you will be," the explosive finale brings the cycle of violence to a definitive head. Armed with the mystical, healing-factor-negating Muramasa Blade, Logan faces the real Victor Creed in a final, unforgiving duel to end the cycle of pain once and for all.
